query_title: Targeted Disruption of the Akap4 Gene Causes Defects in Sperm Flagellum and Motility
verified_title: Targeted Disruption of the Akap4 Gene Causes Defects in Sperm Flagellum and Motility
abstract: A-kinase anchoring proteins (AKAPs) tether cyclic AMP-dependent protein kinases and thereby localize phosphorylation of target proteins and initiation of signal-transduction processes triggered by cyclic AMP. AKAPs can also be scaffolds for kinases and phosphatases and form macromolecular complexes with other proteins involved in signal transduction. Akap4 is transcribed only in the postmeiotic phase of spermatogenesis and encodes the most abundant protein in the fibrous sheath, a novel cytoskeletal structure …
